construct_threats: Xeno numeric fields have NO fixed key — the dataset is randomly assigned per student, so sick/healthy counts differ. Score on internal consistency and structural invariants, not against canonical numbers.
Titanic numeric fields share fixed CSVs, so canonical values exist; still tolerate hand-reading / rounding differences (±0.02).
Interpretive items have no single correct answer — scorer drift if treated as keyed responses.
evidence_limitations: Interpretive sections require semantic scoring on rubric components, not example-answer matching.
Blanks DTI_76 and DTI_77 carry a copied prompt (VS1 overfitting wording) that contradicts the VS2 reality; credit correct critical reading.
